description: This Java interface 'HonoUser' represents a user principal in the Hono authentication context. It extends 'Principal' and provides methods related to user authorities, access token, expiration status, and expiration time.

classes.name: HonoUser
classes.description: An interface representing a user in the Hono authentication framework, providing access to authorities, token, and expiration information.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the authorities granted to this user.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns a JSON Web Token representing this user's claims.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the user's claims have expired.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration time of this user's claims.
